name: orc
lore:
Imagine a world scarred by endless conflict, where the very earth trembles beneath the war drums of the orcish hordes. Born from the bloodlust of Gruumsh, the One-Eyed God, orcs are a force of nature, a storm of muscle and rage that sweeps across the land, leaving only ruin in its wake. Their grayish skin, coarse black hair, and tusks protruding from their brutish faces are a testament to their primal nature, a constant reminder of the savagery that lies within.

Yet, even in the heart of this darkness, flickers of something more can be found. Whispers of King Obould Many-Arrows, who dared to forge a kingdom, a beacon of civilization amidst the chaos. Orcs, though often driven by brute force and a thirst for conquest, are not without a capacity for honor, loyalty, and even, on rare occasions, heroism. Their society, though brutal, is built on a foundation of strength and survival, where the strongest rule and the weak are culled.

Venture into their territory at your own peril, for the path to glory is paved with the bones of the fallen. But remember, even in the most savage heart, a spark of light may still ignite, offering a chance for redemption, or perhaps, a swift and merciless end.
